name: Radio Streamer
description: Companion for 3DX Radio Streamer, a separate desktop app that airs music to your own Shoutcast/Icecast station for a room radio. Reports whether it is installed and running, which audio source it uses, and the exact URL to paste into the room's radio; optionally starts it with the game. The streaming itself happens entirely inside that app, talking to your radio host - this mod never opens a socket, never touches the game or its protocol, and never logs or copies the station password from the app's settings. Installing is a separate, explicitly-run script: bootstrap\Install-RadioStreamer.ps1.
author: 3DXModKit
